description: This file is a shell script used for testing git cherry-pick and branch behaviors. It sets up a repository, creates commits, and runs various test cases to verify the functionality of git cherry commands and cherry-pick operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate passage of time for commits.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository with specified changes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output to verify expected results.
